text: The Exhibition Place employee policies only allows Exhibition Place staff to accumulate 105 hours of lieu time over a one year period. Two operational issues that may cause additional hours of lieu-time for Exhibition Place staff are the negotiations of 6 collective agreements in 2018 and the set-up and operation of the City's low-barrier winter respite shelter in the Better Living Centre. This report is recommending allowance for additional lieu time to address these specific operational issues.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved the payout of hours to staff whose hours worked exceeds the 105 hour lieu policy as a result of collective bargaining or the operation of the City of Toronto's low barrier winter respite facility.
